newsitem.title: USA: CheckFree says industry growing rapidly.
newsitem.headline: CheckFree says industry growing rapidly.

text.p: CheckFree Corp chairman and chief executive Peter Kight told a meeting of institutional investors Tuesday the electronic payments and processing business is poised for enormous growth.

He said all of the companies in the business combined do not have one percent of the overall potential market. But he said one half of the penetration was achieved in the last six months. He predicted future growth will explode, just as it did with automated teller machines. "That is exactly what we think is going to happen here," he said.
Kight said CheckFree's plan to acquire Intuit Services Corp, a unit of Intuit Inc, in a $227.6 million transaction, would keep the company in the lead in the industry.
Under terms of the deal announced Monday, Intuit Inc would receive 12.6 million CheckFree shares, equivalent to a 23 percent stake.
"We didn't want that business to be in somebody else's hands," Kight said. He added that the Intuit Services Corp business is attractive because of its 200 percent growth rate.
"We have a very firm hold on the number one position," he said. "I don't think anybody can catch up in the short run."
He said only if there were a "screwup " by CheckFree would the company be overtaken by a competitor.
He said CheckFree expects the deal to be beneficial because its contribution to the growth rate would be more than than the 23 percent equity stake.

Referring to strategy, Kight said Checkfree does not care how consumers access electronic payments. But he said his company intends to be the "provider of choice" for financial institutions. A coming trend in the business will be the presentation of bills by merchants to consumers through electronic means such as E-mail, Kight said.
CheckFree, which rose 3-3/16 Monday, was up 1/8 to 21-3/8 Tuesday afternoon.
